title: The card in the window
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: 101 north, Thursday. A low building Wood has passed two hundred times. A card in the window today: HELP WANTED. He sees it at forty miles an hour. He doesn't slow down. The strip does.

panels.composition: 101, a low building with a gravel lot and a hand-lettered sign: HECETA FRAME & MATTING. A white card in the window. The Datsun passing at speed.

image.prompt: a low roadside building with a gravel lot and a hand-lettered sign on a coastal highway, a small card in its window, a small car passing at speed, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: HECETA FRAME & MATTING · HELP WANTED (the card).

panels.composition: The card, through the Datsun's side window, blurred: two words.

image.prompt: close on a white card in a shop window seen blurred through a moving car's side window, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD's face. Forward. The card behind him now. BARNABY looking back at it.

image.prompt: a young man's face fixed ahead while driving, a small dog on the seat looking back, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The road ahead, empty, spruce. The building in the mirror, small. The strip slowed down; the car didn't.

image.prompt: a coastal highway ahead through a windshield with a low building shrinking in the side mirror, black and white, no words

notes: Seen at forty. The strip slows; the car doesn't.
